objective: Reintentar exclusivamente en EDARSAHUB Desarrollo la migracion canonica 001 del modulo Sincronizacion Historica despues de corregir la resolucion diferida de columnas nuevas en constraints e indice. No tocar Produccion, no ejecutar ETL y no modificar sync_comercial_abiertas_v2.

queries.name: sync_historical_registry_preflight
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','U') AS catalog_id, OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','U') AS bridge_id, 1/CASE WHEN DB_NAME()='EDARSAHUB' AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','U') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','U') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS preflight_assertion

queries.name: sync_historical_registry_post_columns
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS required_columns, 1/CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS required_columns_assertion FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo') AND name IN ('CategoriaCodigo','EntidadCodigo','CampoFecha','ClaveNegocio','SoportaIncremental','SoportaFullSync','SoportaResume','SoportaSafeStop','VersionContrato','MetadataJSON')

queries.name: sync_historical_registry_post_contract
queries.sql: SELECT 1/CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo') AND name='IX_Sistema_Sync_Catalogo_HistoricalRegistry') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name='CK_Sistema_Sync_Catalogo_ClaveNegocio_JSON') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name='CK_Sistema_Sync_Catalogo_MetadataJSON_JSON') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS registry_contract_assertion
